text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing, and controlling threats to a project or business. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding possible problems before they happen. After that, you need mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to create contingency plans, which are backup plans you can use if something goes wrong. Finally, monitoring is essential. You must watch risks regularly and update your plans when situations change. Good risk management helps organizations avoid surprises and respond quickly to problems, which saves time and money.
